title: sign() hardcodes SHA-256 with no public way to change it
description: In smime-tree/src/sign.rs, sign() hardcodes DigestAlgorithm::Sha256 with the comment 'Always use SHA-256 digest.' There is no public parameter or configuration allowing the caller to choose SHA-384 or SHA-512. The DigestAlgorithm enum is public, the hash_content/digest_alg_oid helpers support all three, but the sign() signature provides no way to use them. A contributor adding SHA-384 support will not know whether the hardcoding is intentional policy or an oversight. The sign() doc comment should state explicitly that only SHA-256 is currently supported, and the comment in the body should explain why (e.g. 'RFC 5751 SHOULD use SHA-256 as default; configurable algorithm support deferred').
close_reason: fixed: doc comment added to sign() documenting SHA-256 hardcoding (MIME-72l.6)
